description.en:
The Trackloaded Dataset is a curated, open Linked Data collection representing African music artists, record labels, and cultural metadata published on Trackloaded.com.

Each entity includes structured attributes such as artist or label name, biography, birth date, social media links, homepage, and external identity connections (e.g. Wikidata, Instagram, MusicBrainz, Discogs ).

Data is published as RDF, Turtle, JSON-LD, and accessible via a live SPARQL endpoint. 

 Vocabularies Used

    foaf:name, foaf:homepage, foaf:bio
    schema:birthDate, schema:founder, schema:location
    mo:member – Music Ontology
    owl:sameAs – External identity links

other_download.title: VoID Metadata (Turtle)
other_download.description: Linked Open Data dataset of African artists, labels, and charts curated by Trackloaded. Includes RDF metadata, SPARQL endpoint, and VoID description for semantic discovery.

example.title: Example on each artists
example.description:
Each artist tag page supports RDF export via query parameters:
    ?rdf=ttl or ?format=ttl – Turtle
    ?rdf=xml or ?format=xml – RDF/XML
    ?rdf=jsonld or ?format=jsonld – JSON

example.title: Example on each labels
example.description:
Each label tag page supports RDF export via query parameters:
    ?rdf=ttl or ?format=ttl – Turtle
    ?rdf=xml or ?format=xml – RDF/XML
    ?rdf=json or ?format=json – JSON

sparql.title: Trackloaded RDF Endpoint
sparql.description: A public SPARQL endpoint exposing structured RDF data of Nigerian artists featured on Trackloaded, including name, homepage, birth date, aliases, biography, and social profiles.
